newsitem.title: USA: USDA to publish WORC petition in Federal Register.
newsitem.headline: USDA to publish WORC petition in Federal Register.

text.p: U.S. Agriculture Department said it would publish a petition on livestock concentration from the Western Organization of Resource Councils (WORC) in the Federal Register to get public input.
USDA said the group's petition asks that USDA initiate rulemaking to restrict certain livestock procurement practices regarding forward contracting and packer-fed cattle.
"This petition raises important issues that need to be fully explored through an open public process," Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said in a statement.
USDA said the petition would be in the Federal Register in the near future.
